display.purpose: Space Grotesk 700, 34px uppercase — iOS-style screen titles and the Gig Mode song name. The largest voice; collapses into a pinned compact bar on scroll.

headline.purpose: Space Grotesk 500, 18px — card song names and setlist track names. Display register for anything that names a piece of music.

body.purpose: Inter 400, 0.8125rem — artist names, notes, field values, metadata, general UI text.

label.purpose: Space Mono 700, 9-11px tracked uppercase dim — section markers, the instrument-panel silkscreen. Tab labels use Space Mono 600.

mono.purpose: Space Mono 700, 13-16px gold — chord charts and Gig Mode key readout, fixed-width so chords column-align over lyrics.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Input/select/textarea focus — a soft gold glow paired with a gold border shift to rgba(199,178,122,0.35), never a hard OS outline. The only elevation event in a flat system.

motion.name: ease-expo-out
motion.purpose: Default entrance/exit easing — tab fades, card-detail slide, Gig Mode song transition, nav-icon pop, auth entrance.

motion.name: spring-overshoot
motion.purpose: The one sanctioned overshoot — the ALL/FAVORITES segmented-control sliding highlight (0.4s) and expand animations only. Never on chrome buttons.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Tactile press feedback — 0.97 on rows/buttons (.press), 0.94 on filter pills (.pill). A small mechanical give.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one loud control on a screen — Rack Gold fill, used once for the main action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #C7B27A; color: #0d0d0f; font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 14px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), filter 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(199,178,122,0.35); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Default for every action that isn't the single primary — gold hairline border and gold text on the chassis.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #C7B27A; font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 14px 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(199,178,122,0.22); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgba(199,178,122,0.5); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(199,178,122,0.1); }

components.name: Filter Pill (active)
components.description: Selected filter — reads as lit: gold text on a lighter seam fill.
components.css: .ds-pill { font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 100px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.12s; } .ds-pill:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-pill-active { background: #1c1c20; color: #C7B27A; }

components.name: Filter Pill (inactive)
components.description: Unselected filter — chassis background, dim silkscreen text, recedes.
components.css: .ds-pill-idle { background: #0d0d0f; color: #5c5b63; font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 100px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.12s, color 0.2s; } .ds-pill-idle:hover { color: #EDEBE6; } .ds-pill-idle:active { transform: scale(0.94); }

components.name: Song Card
components.description: Inset panel for chord/detail — flat near-black rectangle on the chassis, square-ish 8px corners, no shadow at rest.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #131215; border: 1px solid #1e1e22; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 18px; color: #EDEBE6; } .ds-card-meta { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #7a7982; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Dark panel fill, hairline border, gold glow ring on focus. Search field is the rounded rack-chrome exception; data fields are square.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #0f0f11; border: 1px solid #1e1e22; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; color: #EDEBE6; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5c5b63; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(199,178,122,0.35); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(199,178,122,0.05); }

components.name: Bottom Tab Bar
components.description: Fixed four-tab bar, blurred translucent chassis, hairline top border. Active tab gold; inactive dim; active icon plays a one-shot navPop pulse.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; background: rgba(13,13,15,0.82); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(160%); border-top: 1px solid #1e1e22; padding: 8px 12px; } .ds-nav-item { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5c5b63; } .ds-nav-item span { font-size: 18px; } .ds-nav-active { color: #C7B27A; }

narrative.overview: Corda looks like a piece of pro rack gear — a machined front panel of stacked modules — not a webapp. Surfaces are near-black and square-cornered; controls are grouped into physically-routed strips with visible seams; rows are separated by hairline dividers, not shadows or margins. A single warm gold reads as the one status light on the panel. It is designed for the hardest moment there is — a keyboardist glancing at a phone mid-set, one-handed, in a dark room, under an audience — so the whole system optimizes for calm command: read it in a fraction of a second, act, keep playing. Sharp, fast, pro-grade. Beauty is in the tight tolerances and the grid, never in decoration. Corda explicitly rejects four things: an ad-heavy cramped guitar-tab dump; a blue-and-white SaaS dashboard with hero-metric card grids; a bright gamified consumer music app; and skeuomorphic fake-hardware with wood grain and LED meters.
keyCharacteristics: Square corners and 1px hairline dividers — rows are separated by rules, not cards floating in space.
One gold signal light — never a second accent competing for attention.
Grouped controls built as seamed strips (1px gaps on #232328) so transpose, gig nav and reorder read as routed hardware.
Glanceable-first: high ink-on-near-black contrast, generous tap targets, type sized to read at arm's length in the dark.
Three-font system: Space Grotesk titles/lyrics, Space Mono chord/readout labels that column-align, Inter chrome.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one accent: Rack Gold. No second brand color ever joins it. Destructive-red and success-green exist only to signal danger and success, never to decorate. If a screen has two colors fighting to be the highlight, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Warm-White Rule
rules.body: Reading text is #EDEBE6, never pure #FFFFFF. Pure white glares against #0d0d0f; the warm ink is what makes long chord charts readable at a glance on a bright stage.

rules.name: The Column-Align Rule
rules.body: Chord charts and readouts are always Space Mono (or another fixed-width face). A chord sitting over the wrong syllable is a performance error, not a style nit. Proportional fonts are forbidden anywhere a chord sits above a lyric.

rules.name: The Three-Jobs Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk names music (titles, song names, lyrics). Space Mono runs the panel (chords, keys, tick labels). Inter runs the chrome (controls, metadata, artist names). Do not use a display title in Inter or a chord chart in a proportional font.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. Separation comes from hairlines and seams, never from ambient shadow or lift. If an element is casting a drop-shadow, it's wrong.

rules.name: The Seam-Is-Structure Rule
rules.body: Grouped controls are a single 1px-gap grid on a #232328 background so each segment reads as a physically routed strip. Don't fake the grouping with margins or borders — route it through the seam.

dos: Do keep Rack Gold (#C7B27A) as the single accent — active pills, primary action, focus, favorites, chords. One light on the panel.
Do read text in warm ink (#EDEBE6), never pure white, against the #0d0d0f chassis.
Do separate list rows with 1px hairline rules (#1e1e22) and group controls into seamed strips (#232328) — the grid is the structure.
Do set every chord chart and readout in Space Mono so chords column-align over their lyrics.
Do keep corners square; round only physical-control chrome (search field, seam strips, transport) at 10-12px.
Do size and space stage-facing views to be read one-handed, at arm's length, in the dark — legibility beats density.
Do give controls crisp scale(0.97) press feedback; reserve spring/overshoot easing for the segmented pill and expand animations.
donts: Don't add a second accent color. Destructive-red and success-green are state signals only, never decoration — that breaks The One Light Rule.
Don't float cards or drop ambient shadows — separation is hairlines and seams, not lift. A shadow at rest is wrong.
Don't round primary actions, list rows or fields — square corners are the rack. Rounding is only for control-like chrome.
Don't look like a cluttered guitar-tab site, a blue-and-white SaaS dashboard, or a bright gamified music app. Space, grid and hierarchy are the whole point.
Don't fake hardware — no wood grain, no imitation LED meters, no skeuomorphic textures. The instrument feeling comes from the grid and restraint, not mimicry.
Don't use pure #FFFFFF text or gold as a fill-by-the-yard; both destroy the rack-with-one-light effect.
Don't let a chord chart render in a proportional font — a chord over the wrong syllable is a live performance error.
